purpose: Control one concrete TASK_RESEARCH execution instance from task-authority resolution through startup gates, phased source visibility, substantive work, verdict freeze, handoff/return, optional Driver review, recovery and closure. This machine controls execution legality; it does not promote mathematical truth.

authority_and_scope.rule: Scheduler/task-authority/execution/identity/candidate states remain separate dimensions. No other state surface may silently advance this execution instance.

task_authority_contract.official_taskbook_rule: OFFICIAL_TASKBOOK requires the exact current taskbook revision to pass the composite dispatch gate before the execution may enter DISPATCH_READY.
task_authority_contract.direct_user_rule: A current explicit user research instruction is direct task authority and does not require manufacturing an official taskbook. Before substantive work, normalize any explicit startup/process/source-visibility/verdict/return constraints from the current instruction into the concrete execution gate ledger.
task_authority_contract.scheduler_rule: A valid scheduler CLAIM may supply task authority for scheduler-selected TASK_RESEARCH. Normalize any scheduler/task-local execution gates into the concrete gate ledger; scheduler CLAIMED never means EXECUTION_READY.
task_authority_contract.driver_envelope_rule: A Driver dispatch envelope may supply concrete task authority/identity binding. If it points to an official taskbook, the taskbook composite dispatch audit remains mandatory; the envelope cannot waive it.
task_authority_contract.gate_source_rule: All authority kinds normalize task-local execution conditions into the same execution_gates schema before identity/startup classification.

UNBOUND.meaning: A concrete execution is being formed, but its task authority has not yet been resolved under one allowed authority kind.

DISPATCH_READY.meaning: Concrete task authority is resolved. For OFFICIAL_TASKBOOK this includes composite dispatch PASS; for other allowed authority kinds the normalized execution spec is resolved.

CLAIMED.meaning: A concrete conversation/execution has accepted the task but identity/startup requirements are not yet fully resolved.

IDENTITY_READY.meaning: Role identity is locally resolved. The execution must now classify and satisfy all normalized pre-math gates.

PRE_MATH_GATES_PENDING.meaning: At least one normalized PRE_MATH gate lacks durable verified evidence.

EXECUTION_READY.meaning: Identity and all PRE_MATH gates are satisfied; task-scoped substantive work may begin, subject to later gate-ledger action guards and source-visibility gates.

IN_PROGRESS.meaning: Substantive work has begun under the selected task scope and current execution gates.

HANDOFF_READY.meaning: A durable handoff exists and substantive work is paused. The same conversation may explicitly resume this execution only after reconciling the durable handoff and gate ledger; a genuinely new conversation binds a new execution instance.

RETURNED.meaning: A durable research return exists; it is ready either for Driver review or for direct delivery when the authority path does not require Driver review.

DRIVER_REVIEW_PENDING.meaning: Driver is reviewing the durable return and its execution evidence.

RETURN_ACCEPTED.meaning: Driver accepted the return as a valid completion of this execution. This does not by itself promote theorem/candidate/canonical truth and does not imply a successor task.

RETURN_REJECTED.meaning: Driver rejected this execution return or found it non-compliant; any further attempt is a new or explicitly resumed execution according to routing policy.

DELIVERED_UNREVIEWED.meaning: A direct-user task return was delivered without Driver review because no Driver-review step applied to that authority path. This is execution delivery only and does not promote mathematical truth.

RECOVERY_REQUIRED.meaning: Chat/runtime continuity is unreliable or stale. Durable authority/gate/progress evidence must be reconciled before any further substantive work.

REDISPATCH_REQUIRED.meaning: This execution cannot be safely resumed; Driver/scheduler/user may create a fresh execution without changing mathematical truth.

NONSTART_TERMINAL.meaning: A mandatory startup/pre-math gate failed before mathematics. This is an execution/liveness outcome, not a mathematical verdict.

CLOSED.meaning: This reviewed execution instance is closed after the applicable Driver routing/successor evaluation.

action_classes.CONTROL_PLANE_READ: Read governance/task authority/startup material expressly allowed before mathematics.
action_classes.STARTUP_WRITE: Create identity/evidence/branch/stamp artifacts required by a startup gate.
action_classes.MATHEMATICAL_SOURCE_READ: Read a mathematical input, theorem packet, proof source or other task mathematics that is currently visible under the task authority.
action_classes.POST_FREEZE_SOURCE_READ: Read a task-declared source class intentionally withheld until a named independent/raw/blind freeze point, such as current toolbox/prior-art/downstream comparison material opened only in Phase B.
action_classes.MATHEMATICAL_DERIVATION: Perform substantive mathematical reasoning, computation, experiment or formal proof work.
action_classes.CHECKPOINT_WRITE: Persist progress/evidence without terminating the parent objective.
action_classes.VERDICT_FREEZE: Freeze/select a task's primary/final verdict or terminal mathematical classification after all verdict-gating evidence is satisfied.
action_classes.RETURN_WRITE: Persist the research return/handoff required by the task authority.
action_classes.DRIVER_REVIEW: Review evidence and route the execution outcome.

execution_gate_contract.gate_ledger_rule: Every normalized execution gate is instantiated as PENDING for the concrete execution. Only evidence satisfying the gate's declared evidence contract may move it to SATISFIED. A failed gate remains FAILED until Driver/user-authorized recovery/re-dispatch or an explicitly permitted same-execution repair.
execution_gate_contract.action_guard_rule: An action is legal only if both the current execution state allows the action class and every normalized gate guarding that action or an implied parent action is SATISFIED. State permission alone never bypasses an unsatisfied gate.
execution_gate_contract.pre_math_rule: If any normalized gate has phase=PRE_MATH, the execution must enter PRE_MATH_GATES_PENDING after identity resolution and may reach EXECUTION_READY only after every PRE_MATH gate has its declared evidence. A gate guarding MATHEMATICAL_SOURCE_READ also guards POST_FREEZE_SOURCE_READ through action-class implication.
execution_gate_contract.mid_execution_rule: MID_EXECUTION gates block each listed must_precede action at the point of use until SATISFIED. Use VERDICT_FREEZE when a task requires evidence/checkpoints before selecting or freezing its final verdict. Use POST_FREEZE_SOURCE_READ when a source class is hidden until a named Phase-A/raw/independent freeze.
execution_gate_contract.source_visibility_rule: If task authority withholds a source class until a named freeze point, encode a MID_EXECUTION gate whose must_precede includes POST_FREEZE_SOURCE_READ and whose evidence identifies the required freeze artifact/checker. Ordinary currently allowed sources remain MATHEMATICAL_SOURCE_READ and are not blocked by that later gate.
execution_gate_contract.verdict_rule: If the task authority says a checkpoint/checker/audit must occur before the final/primary verdict, encode that condition as a gate whose must_precede includes VERDICT_FREEZE. The researcher may continue other allowed derivation until the gate is satisfied but may not freeze the terminal verdict.
execution_gate_contract.pre_return_rule: PRE_RETURN gates must include RETURN_WRITE in must_precede and therefore prevent RETURN_ARTIFACT_PERSISTED until SATISFIED.
execution_gate_contract.no_gate_rule: If normalized execution_gates is empty, IDENTITY_READY may transition directly to EXECUTION_READY after startup classification.
execution_gate_contract.evidence_rule: A chat statement, progress message, intention, local-only unverified write or oral completion claim is never durable gate evidence when the gate itself requires durable/remote evidence.
execution_gate_contract.failure_rule: Failure of a mandatory PRE_MATH gate transitions to NONSTART_TERMINAL or RECOVERY_REQUIRED/REDISPATCH_REQUIRED as applicable; it never manufactures a mathematical verdict. Failure of a later gate blocks the guarded action and must be recovered, repaired if authorized, or returned as an execution failure rather than silently bypassed.

premath_directive_detection.purpose: Catch obvious prose-only startup gates that were omitted from machine-readable execution_gates in official taskbooks or normalized runtime specs.
premath_directive_detection.rule: If an authority body matches one of these obvious task-local patterns but declares no PRE_MATH gate, the authority/gate audit fails EX-PREMATH-UNDECLARED. Semantic review remains responsible for equivalent wording not caught lexically.

recovery_transitions.reconcile_rule: Recover from durable task-authority evidence where required, durable gate evidence and durable research artifacts. Determine the last legal state and gate ledger whose required evidence actually exists; do not infer completion from chat text.

cross_surface_invariants: Scheduler CLAIMED/IN_PROGRESS/DONE coordinates task leasing only and cannot by itself advance this execution state.
Taskbook base_state=READY is not equivalent to EXECUTION_READY; identity and PRE_MATH gates still apply.
Direct user task authority does not require an official taskbook, but explicit task-local execution constraints must still be normalized into the same gate ledger before substantive work.
Driver dispatch envelopes cannot waive an official taskbook's composite dispatch audit or declared execution gates.
Identity REGISTER_PENDING is nonblocking once a valid local role identity exists, but identity must be resolved before substantive work.

Axiom-candidate promotion and canonical theorem truth are separate from RETURN_ACCEPTED and DELIVERED_UNREVIEWED. A valid negative/null result may be delivered or accepted without becoming canonical truth.
CHECKPOINT_PERSISTED and progress messages are nonterminal under active_turn_liveness.json.
A local-stage PASS or accepted return triggers parent/successor evaluation; it never automatically creates a successor task.
Any mathematical source read or derivation while state is PRE_MATH_GATES_PENDING is an illegal execution transition and invalidates independence/liveness claims that depend on that gate.
A task-declared source class withheld until a named freeze is represented by POST_FREEZE_SOURCE_READ and remains blocked until its guarding gate is SATISFIED.
Any action listed in an unsatisfied execution gate's must_precede, or implied by that guarded action class, is illegal even when the current state would otherwise permit that action class.
Any task-local requirement phrased as before-final-verdict must guard VERDICT_FREEZE rather than relying on prose chronology alone.
Any claimed state advance without the transition's required evidence is invalid and must be reconciled to the last evidenced legal state and gate ledger.
A failed PRE_MATH publication/liveness gate is classified as execution failure, not mathematical failure.

HANDOFF_READY pauses rather than silently ends a same-conversation execution; explicit same-conversation resume requires durable handoff and gate-ledger reconciliation. A new conversation binds a new execution instance.
Direct-user return delivery without Driver review terminates only the execution instance as DELIVERED_UNREVIEWED; it never substitutes for Driver acceptance or mathematical truth promotion.

f5a_regression_guard.scenario: Researcher reports completion but mandatory pre-math remote branch/stamp evidence is absent.
f5a_regression_guard.reason: Oral/chat completion cannot satisfy a durable PRE_MATH publication-liveness gate.
